message.content: {"note_claim": "Helicopters must tilt the rotor disk to move forward, so a video showing forward flight without a tilted rotor disk violates aviation physics.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "The faster the helicopter flies, the more drag (red arrow) it will incur, and the more the pilot must tilt the main rotor thrust forward.", "reason": "The page substantiates the general physical principle that forward flight requires tilting the main rotor thrust forward, though it says nothing about the video itself."}

parsed.note_claim: Helicopters must tilt the rotor disk to move forward, so a video showing forward flight without a tilted rotor disk violates aviation physics.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: The faster the helicopter flies, the more drag (red arrow) it will incur, and the more the pilot must tilt the main rotor thrust forward.
parsed.reason: The page substantiates the general physical principle that forward flight requires tilting the main rotor thrust forward, though it says nothing about the video itself.
